matchupOfTheWeek.title: Rush Offense vs. Run Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our rush offense grades 65/100 (above average) against BUF's run defense at 6/100 (among the NFL's worst) — the widest statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's the thing about this trip to Buffalo: we're staring down the widest statistical mismatch on the board, and it's happening to be exactly where we need it. Our rush offense grades at 65—solid, above average work—and we're running it into a Bills run defense that's somehow managed a 6/100, which is genuinely among the worst in football. That's the lane we need to live in on Sunday. The problem is everything else: our pass offense is limping along at 23/100, our pass protection is a catastrophic 16/100, and we're walking into a stadium where Buffalo's pass rush grades out at 61/100. After Drake Maye's three-turnover disaster against Jacksonville, we need disciplined, ground-heavy football and actual protection schemes, not another airshow where he's getting killed. The silver lining is that we've stolen a couple from these guys before (2-3 in the last five meetings), and Buffalo's overall defense ranks 24th in EPA/play despite their gaudy offensive numbers. If we can pound the rock and keep their elite offense off the field, this +7 line starts to make sense.
